decision: Every approved AI suggestion lands in one audit log with a tab per system: who approved, which model version, and the outcome measured later
why: Trust in AI grows from track record; a place where suggestions meet their outcomes (including reverted ones) makes the track record visible.
value: One place to answer 'did the AI help?' for any system.

decision: Outcomes are measured after the fact (units in 48 h, dispute won, leak stopped) and new approvals show 'measured in 24 h' until then
why: Judging a suggestion by how confident it sounded is how bad models survive; only outcomes count.
alternative: Log the approval and stop there.
value: Reverted suggestions stay visible next to the wins.

decision: Approvals made anywhere in the portfolio arrive as action.performed events on the shared world and appear here within a tick, each linked to its trace
why: An audit log that needs a nightly export is always a day behind the incident you're investigating.
alternative: Batch import approvals from each system.
value: Approve a price in Product Hub and it's in the audit log, with its trace, seconds later.

decision: Every AI card in every stack gets 'How this was made' (sources with scores, tool calls with latency, model route, eval score, tokens, simulated cost, link to the Pulse harness trace), added by chrome from the shared CSS contract
why: Editing hundreds of cards in four frameworks would drift; the AI surface is one contract, so one enhancer covers them all.
value: Provenance is on every AI card, including ones built later.
